 Thanksgiving Weather Forecast 2026: Regional Outlook
 Planning for Thanksgiving 2026? Read the regional weather outlook, understand its limits, and find out when to check local forecasts before you travel.
 by Farmers' Almanac Staff Updated: November 7, 2026 
 Email Facebook Pinterest X 
 Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, November 26, 2026 . If you’re planning a road trip, a flight, or an outdoor family gathering, this regional outlook offers an early starting point—and explains when to check more detailed forecasts.
 Forecast coverage: Monday, November 23, through Thursday, November 26, 2026.
 Outlook type: Long-range regional guidance for the contiguous United States.
 This outlook describes broad regional conditions. It does not establish the weather for a particular city, travel route, or hour of Thanksgiving Day. Its coverage also does not extend through the return-travel weekend, November 27–29 .
 Farmers Almanac Online Membership 
 Regional Thanksgiving Weather Outlook
 Farmers’ Almanac’s published outlook includes the following regional expectations. Use them for early preparation, then check local forecasts as your travel and gathering dates approach.
 Northeast & New England 
 Published outlook: Cool and mainly fair, with possible flurries in northern areas and at higher elevations.
 Planning tip: Check conditions at your destination and along your route separately, particularly when traveling between coastal areas and inland or mountain locations.
 Great Lakes, Ohio Valley & Midwest 
 Published outlook: Colder conditions, with scattered snow showers or flurries possible.
 Planning tip: Before driving, review state transportation reports alongside the local forecast. A broad regional outlook cannot tell you whether a particular road will be affected.
 Southeast 
 Published outlook: Generally mild and pleasant, with dry weather and sunshine favored.
 Planning tip: For outdoor meals, football games, or community events, check the hourly forecast closer to Thanksgiving. Regional guidance cannot guarantee a dry gathering.
 North Central: Plains & Rockies
 Published outlook: Cold conditions, with light snow possible in the northern Plains and Rockies, especially at higher elevations.
 Planning tip: Evaluate mountain portions of your trip separately from lower-elevation stops. Check road restrictions and conditions before departure.
 South Central 
 Published outlook: Mostly seasonable, with cooler conditions inland and colder weather possible in western or higher-terrain areas.
 Planning tip: Use a destination-specific forecast when deciding what to pack. Conditions across a large forecast region may differ considerably.
 Northwest
 Published outlook: Periods of rain across the Pacific Northwest.
 Planning tip: Review road conditions before setting out, and check mountain routes separately rather than assuming conditions will match nearby lower elevations.
 Southwest
 Published outlook: Cooler, mixed conditions, including some Northern California rain and light mountain snow in parts of the interior West.
 Planning tip: Check each major stop on your itinerary, especially when traveling between coastal, desert, and mountain locations.
 Farmers’ Almanac Thanksgiving Weather Forecast 2026, showing the outlook for November 23–26 across the United States, including areas with rain, snow showers, colder conditions, and mild weather. 
 Thanksgiving Travel: What to Check Before You Leave
 Weather at your destination is only part of the picture. Include your departure point, driving route, connecting airports, and return journey when reviewing conditions.
 Before leaving:
 Check local forecasts and alerts. Use the National Weather Service for the places you will visit and travel through.
 Review road conditions. Consult the relevant state transportation department for closures, restrictions, and route information.
 Check your airline’s updates. Follow flight status and any published travel advisories.
 Recheck the return trip. This outlook ends on Thanksgiving Day; it should not be used as a forecast for Friday through Sunday.
 Keep plans flexible. Decide ahead of time how you would adjust your departure or route if conditions change.
 Neither a favorable regional outlook nor an absence of storm language guarantees an uninterrupted trip.
 Planning an Outdoor Thanksgiving?
 For an outdoor meal, neighborhood football game, or parade outing, the most useful information will be the forecast for your location and event hours.
 As Thanksgiving approaches, check:
 Temperature during the gathering.
 Wind and how cold it may feel.
 The likelihood and timing of precipitation.
 Any local weather alerts.
 Have an indoor alternative ready, and make the final decision using current local information rather than the long-range regional outlook alone.
 The 2027 Farmers’ Almanac features weather forecasts, gardening tips, and moon phases, available now on Amazon. 
 When to Check Thanksgiving Weather Updates
 Different forecast products answer different questions.
 For early planning: A long-range outlook provides broad regional guidance. Don’t interpret it as a precise forecast of temperatures, precipitation timing, or snowfall totals.
 As the holiday approaches: NOAA’s Climate Prediction Center publishes 6–10-day and 8–14-day outlooks. These describe temperature and precipitation departures from normal over a period; they do not specify the weather during Thanksgiving dinner.
 Within about a week of your plans: Consult National Weather Service local forecasts for more specific information. Continue checking nearer departure and before an outdoor event, since details can change.
 Use official warnings and current transportation information when making immediate travel decisions.
 Thanksgiving Weather Forecast FAQs
 When is Thanksgiving in 2026?
 Thanksgiving Day is Thursday, November 26, 2026 , according to the federal holiday calendar.
 How far ahead can Thanksgiving weather be predicted?
 Long-range outlooks offer broad guidance before detailed local forecasts become available. They should not be treated as exact predictions for an individual city or event. Always check the forecast’s valid dates and geographic coverage.
 When should I check the local Thanksgiving forecast?
 Start checking local forecasts within approximately a week of your plans, then review updates closer to departure or your gathering. No fixed lead time makes every forecast certain.
 Does this outlook cover Thanksgiving weekend?
 No. The published outlook summarized here covers November 23–26, 2026 . Check separate forecasts for travel and activities scheduled for November 27–29 .
